header.title: Account
header.description: Your profile, security, and API access credentials.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: How you appear across the DAAS workspace.
profile.saveFailed: Could not save your profile changes.

organization.title: Team & access
organization.description: Multi-user workspaces, invites, roles, and SSO aren't implemented yet — this is a single-user account today. The <field>Organization</field> field on your Profile is a free-text label, not a shared workspace.
organization.comingSoonBody: This surface is shown as a placeholder and does not imply supported backend functionality. Multi-user collaboration will ship with SSO.

security.title: Security
security.sessionsBody: Sign-in tokens are stateless JWTs today, so individual sessions can't be listed or revoked. A per-session refresh-token table would be needed to support this.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: Use API keys to integrate DAAS with your data pipelines. Keys never expire but can be revoked.
apiKeys.treatLikePasswordsBody: The full key is shown once, right after you generate it, and never again — only the short prefix is kept afterward. Never commit them to source control.
apiKeys.revokeConfirmBody: Any pipeline or integration using {prefix}… will stop working immediately. This cannot be undone.
apiKeys.dialogDescription: Copy it now — for security, it won't be shown again after you close this dialog.

activity.title: Activity log
activity.description: There is no audit-log table in this build yet, so recent actions can't be listed here.
activity.notTrackedBody: A persisted audit-log table would be needed to show real account and project activity here.

billing.title: Plan & billing
billing.description: Billing isn't implemented yet — this deployment has no plans, usage limits, or invoices.
billing.noBillingBody: Pricing and plans will be finalized at general availability.
